aboutIntro.eyebrow: Built for the hydrocarbon logistics sector
aboutIntro.title: Convert physical tank levels into automatic dispatch orders. Monitor volume in real time, anticipate critical replenishment 48 hours in advance, and secure every delivery with satellite geofencing.

problemCards.title: Traditional fuel distribution leaves too much to chance
problemCards.description: Manual dipstick measurements, reactive WhatsApp requests, and empirical tanker fleet allocation lead to heavy financial losses from stockouts, excessive freight costs, and zero operational traceability.

yields.title: Manual Dipsticking & Fuel Stockouts
yields.description: Stations still check tanks using physical dipsticks or Excel. This triggers human errors, unmonitored evaporation losses, and 2-3 hours of delay per order, causing catastrophic stockouts during high-demand holidays.

pests.title: Chaotic Emergency Orders
pests.description: Between 35% and 45% of delivery requests arrive as last-minute emergencies via phone calls and WhatsApp chats. This shatters the distributors scheduled routes, forces half-loaded trucks, and skyrockets freight expenses.

climate.title: Fleet Allocation Without Capacity Checks
climate.description: Manually assigning drivers and tankers without verifying volume against tank compartment capacity results in severe delivery delays, capacity mismatches, and compliance risks with safety regulations.

problemPanel.introText: Hydrocarbon supply cannot depend on frantic phone calls or imprecise dipsticks. With FuelGuard, every connected tank continuously broadcasts its level in real time, anticipating demand before business operations halt.
problemPanel.expandedText: FuelGuard bridges IoT telemetry in stationary tanks with tanker fleet dispatching in a seamless B2B end-to-end platform.

solutionPanel.title: Turn telemetry data into automated dispatching
solutionPanel.subtitle: Predict demand. Dispatch with pinpoint accuracy.

alerts.title: Tank IoT Monitoring
alerts.description: Hydrostatic and ultrasonic sensors transmit 24/7 tank readings in underground or surface tanks, flagging critical thresholds automatically.

marketplace.title: Automated Order Generation
marketplace.description: Once a safety threshold is reached, the system creates the order with product type, required volume, available space (ullage), and delivery window.

ndvi.title: B2B Dispatch Management
ndvi.description: A centralized dashboard where distributors accept or reject orders in one click, verify bank deposit slips, and manage fulfillment.

chill.title: Smart Fleet Allocation
chill.description: The matching engine pairs the order with an eligible driver and a tanker whose capacity fits the requested volume, eliminating allocation mistakes.

nutrition.title: Geofencing & Valve Lock
nutrition.description: En-route telemetry and electronic valve unlocking: discharge valves are only authorized when the tanker is inside the verified customer coordinates.

climate.title: Digital Delivery Docket
climate.description: Auditable digital delivery receipt with initial and final meter readings, discharge duration, and recipient signatures compliant with OSINERGMIN.

expectedOutcomes.title: OPTIMIZE YOUR LOGISTICS OPERATION AND PREVENT COSTLY FUEL OUTAGES.

recommendation.title: NEVER HALT A STATION DUE TO FUEL DEPLETION
recommendation.description: With FuelGuard, your distributor knows 48 to 72 hours beforehand exactly when your tank requires replenishment. Say goodbye to manual dipsticks and emergency dispatches: run your operations with guaranteed supply.

featureProduct.tagline:
The Smart Guardian of Your Fuel Supply.
24/7 Continuous Operation.
featureProduct.title:
Your tank alerts.
Your fleet responds.
featureProduct.moreText: FuelGuard synchronizes continuous readings from IoT sensors in customer tanks with the distributor dispatch portal. It verifies bank payment slips, assigns tankers matching exact compartment volume, monitors routes with live geofences, and keeps discharge valves locked until reaching authorized coordinates.

roleBenefits.title: A comprehensive solution for both sides of the fuel supply chain
roleBenefits.description: Whether you are a logistics distributor operating a tanker fleet or a station manager looking to ensure uninterrupted fuel stock, FuelGuard tailors its workflow to your requirements.

steps.title: Register fleet and authorized drivers
steps.description: Set up your tankers with gross capacity, compartments, and fuel types, alongside driver certifications and hazardous material licenses.
bullets: Centralized management of tanker units and fuel compatibility.
Verification of licensed commercial drivers and compliance status.
Real-time availability monitoring to prevent fleet bottlenecks.

steps.title: Receive IoT-triggered order requests
steps.description: Eliminate chaotic phone calls and messaging chats. Incoming orders are cleanly formatted with volume, product, destination, and delivery date.
bullets: Automatic sensor trigger whenever client tank falls below safety threshold.
Centralized order pipeline displaying urgency ratings.
Streamlined validation of bank deposit slips and purchase orders.

steps.title: Assign resources with verified capacity
steps.description: FuelGuards allocation engine pairs orders with compatible tankers, strictly verifying that capacity meets or exceeds requested volume.
bullets: Zero instances of tankers dispatched with inadequate capacity.
Automated suggestions based on vehicle availability, route, and priority.
Instant confirmation dispatched to buyer with assigned unit details.

steps.title: Supervise en route and settle deliveries
steps.description: Track the vehicle under active geofencing, authorize discharge upon arrival, and generate an auditable digital delivery receipt.
bullets: Electronic valve lockout enforced whenever unit is outside geofence.
Automated recording of fuel level before and after discharge.
Digital receipt generation compliant with OSINERGMIN safety audits.

steps.title: Install IoT sensors on storage tanks
steps.description: Link your stationary fuel tanks to the FuelGuard platform using continuous hydrostatic or ultrasonic level monitoring devices.
bullets: Compatible with underground and above-ground diesel and gasoline tanks.
Accurate readings for current volume, fuel level, and ullage space.
No expensive proprietary consoles or complex wiring required.

steps.title: Configure replenishment safety thresholds
steps.description: Define the minimum percentage or gallon limit that automatically triggers a preventive restocking order before dipping into risk reserves.
bullets: Early warnings delivered 48 to 72 hours prior to tank depletion.
Fully automated or one-click purchase approval modes.
Shield your business from running out of fuel during peak holidays.

steps.title: Track order dispatch in real time
steps.description: Observe live progress from your dashboard as your distributor approves the request, allocates the tanker, and departs toward your station.
bullets: Clear lifecycle status: Pending, Approved, Dispatched, Delivered.
View assigned driver credentials and tanker license plate.
Estimated arrival time (ETA) and scheduled unloading window.

steps.title: Confirm receipt and balance inventory
steps.description: Confirm discharge with digital sign-off and receive certified delivery documentation to maintain accurate book inventory.
bullets: Single-click confirmation to close out the fulfillment cycle.
Complete archive of past orders, deposits, and volume trends.
Downloadable PDF audit dossiers for regulatory compliance.

aboutMission.title: Our Mission
aboutMission.subtitle: IoT innovation driving reliability in hydrocarbon logistics.
aboutMission.focusedOn: Specialized in B2B Fuel Supply Logistics
aboutMission.statement: We digitize fuel distribution logistics to eradicate unplanned stockouts and dispatch errors.
aboutMission.description: FuelGuard is a B2B platform engineered for fuel transport and distribution enterprises operating tanker fleets. We connect IoT level sensors in customer storage tanks with a centralized platform that automates replenishment, verifies tanker vehicle capacity, enforces geofenced unloading security, and ensures compliance with OSINERGMIN safety regulations.

testimonials.title: What industry leaders say about FuelGuard

cards.quote: Running out of diesel over holiday weekends was an operational nightmare that cost us fleet accounts. Now the sensor measures around the clock and orders generate in one click, eliminating dipstick risks.
cards.author: Carlos Campoblanco

cards.quote: Checking tanks manually with a dipstick took almost 3 hours every day. FuelGuard gives us peace of mind with exact telemetry data and zero fear of duplicate purchase orders.
cards.author: Sebastián Rojas

cards.quote: Receiving alerts 48 to 72 hours ahead transformed our profitability. We stopped assembling expensive emergency runs and now have clear visibility of gallons, tankers, and transaction codes.
